A.explanation: The wavefronts pass through the gap between the sea walls and spread out into curved arcs on the beach, which is diffraction.

B.explanation: Doppler shift needs a moving source or observer changing the observed wavelength, but the spacing of the wavefronts shows no motion-induced asymmetry.

C.explanation: Interference needs two coherent sources overlapping to give maxima and minima, but here there is only one set of wavefronts spreading from a single gap.

D.explanation: Superposition is the general adding of displacements, but the named behaviour of spreading around the ends of the sea walls is diffraction.
